text:
lara (People Ops): Heads up @toni — Maria (maria) returned from parental leave today and pinged me. Her net looks off. Can payroll confirm withholding breakdown?

toni (Payroll): Sure — can you paste a redacted paystub snippet or last4 and pay period?

lara (People Ops): Redacted stub below (she DM'd it):
```
Pay period: 04/01/2026 - 04/15/2026
Gross: $5,000.00
Leave payout: $2,000.00
Federal tax: $1,100.00 (18.3%)
State tax: $760.00 (7.6%)
Net: $3,140.00
```
Employee: Maria Lopez, EmpID 47210, last4 9876

devin (Eng Manager): Maria updated her address in mid-March moving from NY to OR. She expected OR withholding (no state income tax). She confirmed the self-serve change.

ton i (Payroll): @payroll-bot pull payrun for EmpID 47210 period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15 and show state/jurisdiction used.

payroll-bot: Retrieving payrun 2026-04-15 for EmpID 47210... Record found. Payrun shows leave payout coded as "LVM-LUMP". System applied federal supplemental flat rate for lump-sum (22%) on the payout AND standard federal withholding on base pay (so effective federal percent looks lower than a pure supplemental). State withholding applied to NY jurisdiction (resident state flagged as NY in payroll profile) at 4% + NY local tax component — total 7.6%. Address change to OR exists in HR profile but residency flag in payroll did not update before payroll cut. Creating ticket PAY-5991 for jurisdiction correction and off-cycle reversal.

lara (People Ops): Ok — so this is a multi-state mismatch, not just a supplemental double-apply?

ton i (Payroll): Correct. Two issues: 1) leave payout treated as supplemental (intentional) which changes federal calc flow, and 2) state residency used in payroll was stale (NY) so state tax withheld incorrectly. We'll reverse the state withholding and re-run federal allocation if needed.

devin (Eng Manager): Do we need Maria's approval to run a state refund off-cycle? She needs the net to cover childcare costs this week.

ton i (Payroll): For payroll system errors we can process corrections without employee consent. ETA 2 business days for state reversal + up to 3 business days if we need an off-cycle federal recompute. We'll mark as priority since it's a residency/jurisdiction error.

maria (Employee): Thanks all — appreciate the fast help. I did update my address in Workday on 2026-03-18, happy to forward confirmation email.

ton i (Payroll): Please drop the confirmation here or DM to me and I'll attach to PAY-5991. Also tagging payroll ops to confirm W-2 state residency flags for year-end.

lara (People Ops): I'll message Maria with the ticket link and ETA. @devin can you remind your team leads to confirm any recent address changes before cutoffs?

devin (Eng Manager): Will do. Sorry Maria — we'll make sure this gets fixed.

(reacts: :raised_hands: from maria, :eyes: from toni)
